[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for keeping a gaming chair clean and in good condition include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Vacuum regularly with a soft brush attachment.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Use leather conditioner for leather features to prevent cracking.
